evidence: Reads the nested provider at input+0x8 and a signed byte at provider record+0xa2; the selected flag path fetches properties 0x23, 0x2f, 0x29, 0x57, and 0x41, scales/converts them, and combines their integer values. The alternate path fetches player attributes 0x2d, 0x37, and 0x5a before a separate calculation. Caller invokes it for selectors 0, 1, and 2 and uses the results in its selection computation. decompiled/main/main_0053.c:32713-32804; caller decompiled/main/main_0053.c:32457-32523.

Requires attribute_context_status_equals_3 to be false, then takes a successful indirect dispatch path before loading the dword at input+0x10. It clamps values above 3 to 3, increments and stores the count, and tail-calls populate_context_record_from_nested_attribute_values with selector 0 exactly when the incremented count is 4. decompiled/main/main_0090.c:37831-37859; caller tail-call decompiled/main/main_0090.c:51018-51021.

The routine combines an opaque initial lookup, status queries for selectors 2 and 1, a guarded reconciliation call, further object resolution/construction, and cleanup, but there is not enough evidence to describe its overall role. decompiled/main/main_0066.c:34565-34641; no indexed callers.

Initializes the output dword to -1, requires context status selector 0x13 to equal 4, then checks the global nested provider handle and accepts an input index from 0 through 3. A table maps the index to one of four property IDs (0x0c, 0x1f, 0x2b, 0x2e); it fetches that nested-provider float, subtracts the matching baseline value, converts to integer, and stores the result. decompiled/main/main_0125.c:49179-49240; no indexed callers.

For selector 0x13, rejects status values 1, 3, 4, 7, or 8; for other values it requires selector 0x15 nonzero. It then calls evaluate_attribute_context_compatibility for selectors 2 and 1 and rejects when their boolean results differ; if they match, it returns whether the AND of two global dwords at 0x7003acd ef8 and +8 equals all ones. (Address is 0x7003acdef8; source uses base 0x7003acd000+0xef8.) decompiled/main/main_0081.c:42667-42728; no indexed callers.
